confidence_note: Room segmentation is trajectory-based (recurrence + spatial clustering), not semantic -- room IDs are arbitrary, not real room names, and a hub/junction where 3+ spaces meet can under-segment (see segment_rooms docstring). All rooms share one continuous VIO coordinate frame (one walkthrough), so no independent room-to-room registration was needed here -- that will NOT be true for independently captured photo/video-tier rooms (Phase 3/4), which need real registration. Drift correction, if enabled, is a linear translation-only loop-closure redistribution, not full pose-graph SLAM.
